summary: Quezon 3rd District representative with 106 principal-authored bills. Authored a disinformation penalty bill alongside mandatory body-worn cameras for law enforcement, plus FOI and anti-dynasty bills. Also authored the BARMM first parliamentary elections bill and a bill postponing barangay and SK elections. Co-authored the national minimum wage.
caveat: The postponement bill and the transparency bills pull in opposite directions; the +2 reflects that mix. Disinformation bill text not reviewed for safeguards.

economic.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.
